title: Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City Reunited with Survivor and Family
description: Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City reunites with Damian Sexton and his family at Coast Guard Station Atlantic City in Atlantic City, N.J., Wednesday, August 5, 2015. Sexton was medevaced by Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City after he fell overboard Aug. 1, 2015
